Each stub's #[tool] handler is service::stub_answer: an invalid_params refusal opening \"REFUSED:\" (classed `refused` in the usage ledger, written under the stub's own name), naming what to do and, for a fold, the exact survivor call built from the caller's arguments. The old bodies stay as <tool>_kept, so a restore re-points the handler. usage_report gains `retired_stubs` (deprecation::stub_counts: each stub's count in the window, zeros included, called/not_called, re_count). find_tools never offers a stub but still weighs words over its description, so no other tool's score moves.
